answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 377 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is logged against the saffron challenge, the nadir audit can replay the bridge history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2445 identities would post 3943 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
